text:
Hannah Lee: just opened a docs PR that consolidates the rate-limits, quotas, and pricing snippets and updates the SDK examples to v2. Adds a tiny "how billing flows" worked example and a sed one-liner to remap old->new metric names. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/999
Marco Diaz: can you add a concrete numerical example showing reserved -> burst -> payg ordering? customers ask for a simple rule they can paste into KB.
Hannah Lee: yep, one-line rule + 2-row mini table. reserved consumes first N tokens, burst fills up to cap, remainder billed at pay-as-you-go.
Sonia Patel: heads up: a grep found `X-Metering` in a few snippets. v2 uses `X-RW-Metering-Context` and we prefer `client.withQuota({tier: '...'})` in examples.
Hannah Lee: replacing headers and switching to the fluent API now.
infra-bot: lint: deprecated header found in examples/quotas.md line 44. Panel JSON metric mismatch: panel uses "quota.requests_by_env" but query shows "quota.requests_env_total".
Marco Diaz: align the metric names and add a small migration map (old -> new) so SREs can update dashboards quickly. Also include a sed example.
Hannah Lee: added a migration table and this sed snippet: `sed -i 's/quota.requests_by_env/quota.requests_env_total/g' dashboards.json` as a fenced block.
Sonia Patel: add one-line Dedicated migration note: "On-prem agents <=v3.1 emit X-Metering — upgrade to agent v3.2+ for X-RW-Metering-Context." link agent changelog.
Hannah Lee: added the note and linked release notes. Also added a parenthetical: "Embeddings billed per vector unit, not tokens" with link to embeddings billing.
docs-bot: PR 999 updated by hannah — headers replaced, migration map added. snippet-check failed (missing mock fixture).
Marco Diaz: I'll push a tiny offline fixture that instantiates a mocked v2 client and asserts the header and presence of `.withQuota()`. No network.
Marco Diaz: pushed fixture to branch. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/999/files#diff-a2
docs-bot: snippet-check passed after fixture. Preview: https://deploy-preview-999--docs.redwood.ai/usage/quotas-pricing
Sonia Patel: preview looks good. small formatting nit: use single backticks for inline flags and fenced blocks for full code per linter.
Hannah Lee: standardized formatting and re-ran linter. Merging after Netlify completes. I'll ping #support and #eng-runtime about metric rename and header change so dashboard alerts and agents don't surprise customers.
Marco Diaz: thanks  also add the fixture to docs-test-suite so future PRs can't regress this.
Hannah Lee: will add test-suite follow-up. merging now, thanks everyone. :tada:
